caseNameFull: St. Marie v. United States, Trustee
attorneys: .Messrs. Thomas L. Sloan and Williamson S. Summers for petitioners. Solicitor General Biddle and Assistant Attorney General Littell for the United States.

opinions.text: The motion to proceed on the typewritten record is denied. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit is denied for the reason that application therefor; vas not made within the time provided by law.
